items.name: sfx_stamps
items.text: Three separate hits of a heavy wooden official seal stamp slammed down onto paper on a wooden desk, a firm satisfying thump each time, with a full second of silence between the hits. Close, dry, no music, no voice.

items.name: sfx_whoosh
items.text: Four separate quick whooshes of a sheet of paper flicked fast past the microphone, each one short and airy, with a second of silence between them. Clean, no music, no voice.

items.name: sfx_pops
items.text: Playful cartoon sound effects, one after another with a second of silence between each: a short cartoon pop, a soft magical sparkle shimmer, a small bright temple bell ding, a springy cartoon boing. No music, no voice.

items.name: sfx_thread
items.text: A taut silk thread plucked once like a low string with a twang, then a thin thread snapping, then a pair of scissors snipping once, each separated by a second of silence. Close and clean, no music, no voice.
